app.name: MedKnow
app.tagline: Understand your medications from a photo.
disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.body: MedKnow is an AI-based information and comprehension tool. It does not provide a diagnosis, medical advice or a prescription, and it never replaces a doctor or a pharmacist. Results may contain errors or omissions. Never start, stop or change a treatment based only on MedKnow. Always check the information with your pharmacist or doctor. In an emergency, a severe reaction or an accidental ingestion, immediately call your local emergency services or a poison control center.
disclaimer.dataNote: Your photo is sent to a third-party AI service to be analyzed. Nothing is stored on our servers. You can exclude your name and address from the frame before sending.

about.title: About and limits
about.intro: MedKnow explains medication information printed on prescriptions, boxes, labels and leaflets, in plain language, with voice playback and three languages.
about.howBody: You take a photo; your browser compresses it locally and sends it once to an analysis service. An AI model reads the image and returns a structured result, verified by safety filters and a small set of known critical-interaction rules. The result stays in your browser for the session only.
about.limit1: The AI can misread handwriting or a poor-quality photo; MedKnow flags uncertainty instead of hiding it.
about.limit2: Brand names vary by country; an uncommon name may be uncertain.
about.limit3: Interaction detection is not exhaustive: it depends on the AI model and a small set of local rules. Supplements, herbal products, foods and alcohol are not taken into account unless printed.
about.limit4: MedKnow knows nothing about your clinical context (age, weight, pregnancy, allergies, kidneys, other treatments).
about.limit5: A result saying “no interaction detected” does not mean no interaction exists.
about.limit6: MedKnow is an information tool. It is not a medical device and is not intended for clinical use.
about.privacyBody: No account, no cookie, no tracker. Your photo is processed in memory and sent once over HTTPS to the AI provider; nothing is stored on our servers. Results live in your browser's session storage and are erased when you close the tab, or immediately with “Erase my data”. Some free AI tiers may use sent content to improve their services — use fictional documents for tests.
manual.title: Type the medicine names
manual.hint: Add 2 to 10 names to get general information and known interactions. No photo is needed.

manual.emptyName: Please enter a name before adding another.
manual.note: Results are general information only — they do not reflect your prescription.
